comments.text: I am 68 and I can say that other than learning the basics in the first 6 years of elementary school the rest was a complete waste of time. 7th, 8th and 9th grade was nothing more than repetition of what I already knew. Frustrated hearing the same old same old I quit school in the first quarter of 10th grade. Took the GED test, passed first time and had a High school degree while my class was still stuck in 10th grade. No computers back in the 1970's but we had books. If it was a subject I was Intrested in I sucked up information like a sponge. Back in school I struggled with memorizing what General fought in what battle yet I loved History. In short I have been self employed since 1989 and now at 68 I would not change a thing. If I had AI back in 1989 I would have been unstoppable as far as income earning goes. I still had to rely on books for knowledge and research.  Now research is measured in milliseconds. Other than the social aspect of school I have nothing good to say about it.  Starting College. Better make sure that dream job will be there for you in 4 years even if AI does not advance more than where we are at here today in 2026 and you know it's only going to get smarter and faster.  As far as schools go,for the most part they are finished in my opinion.
